answer: Forging identities requires acquiring fresh hardware and paying escalating stake fees on every island of the network, so the marginal cost of a sybil swarm grows faster than its expected reward, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. Each new agent must stake a unique crystal bound to a hardware enclave and pass a liveness challenge seeded by a random whisper from three existing peers. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
